segments.text: The primary heroine of Memories Off 2nd, Hotaru is in her third year at Hamasaki High School. She often acts childish and immature, and is sometimes an airhead. Her favourite hobby is the piano. Her best friend is Tomoe, and Ken is her boyfriend.
Taken From Wikipedia.
Best friend of Ken, he is in his third year at Hamasaki High School and is the captain of the soccer club.
Taken From Wikipedia.
A student and a soccer loving guy who aspires to go to film school. He has a job as a part-time worker at a family restaurant. His girlfriend is Hotaru Shirakawa.

"If you act for someone else, both you and everyone else can be happy" is the motto. Honest and pure, but one could also say that he is naive. Due to the "customs" of his "family", he has a fiancée whose name and face he does not know. The identity of this person is to be revealed on the day of Itsuki's 17th birthday -— his "blessing" day. Itsuki himself accepts the existence of his fiancée as something natural, and he spends his high school life without interest in romance because "there is someone already decided". He relies heavily on his childhood friend Amaha Nene, who is also part of the same "family", and is the first person he consults when he has trouble.
translated from digital setting materials

An outstanding scholarship student. While maintaining top grades in her year, she is also dedicated to her part-time job at the family restaurant "Ressac," saving desperately to cut down on her daily food expenses.

After her mother was invited to "the family" when Sae was young, Sae's household collapsed. Her brother took his own life, leaving behind the words, "Don’t be killed by righteousness." As a result, Sae has come to hate her mother, "the family", and all related "families", trying to escape this environment on her own. She is engaged to Itsuki and was informed of this relationship a year earlier than Itsuki, but had no intention of accepting it —- until she happened to meet Itsuki.
translated from digital setting materials
Nene is part of the same as Itsuki and they are childhood friends. She is very sociable and can get along with anyone, being liked by everyone at school and in the "family".

According to the "tradition", children of the "family" must have an arranged marriage, but Nene is allowed an exception and currently has no partner. From a young age, she has thought of Itsuki as "hers", and her feelings remain unchanged regardless of whether Itsuki has a fiancée. She closely observes Itsuki's every move and records details in her "Ikkun Memory Notebook", which currently contains 62 volumes. She keeps a watchful eye for any women who approach Itsuki, and she devises various strategies to keep him away from them if necessary.
translated from digital setting materials
A classmate of Itsuki, she is a member of the literary club. She is not good at talking to people and usually spends her time reading alone at school.

Her love for light novels started when she read the works of the author Suzushiro Rein, and currently she posts her own novels online under the pen name "Bokke waon." Itsuki and Kazune hit it off because Itsuki was a fan of "Bokke waon". Kazune confides in Itsuki about her dream of becoming a novelist, which she had never revealed to anyone, and discusses her concerns about possibly being a victim of stalking. Gradually, Itsuki becomes a source of emotional support for her.
translated from digital setting materials

segments.text: A half-Japanese, half-German born to a Japanese father and a German mother. Influenced by his father, she developed a desire to "play soccer in Japan!" and came to Japan as a sports scholarship student. She possesses the skill level of a youth national representative, but after suffering a major injury, she has become self-destructive due to his first setback. She plans to induce the school to cancel his scholarship by deliberately engaging in misconduct so that she can return to Germany. At that time, she asks Itsuki, whom she met, to "pretend to be my boyfriend".
translated from digital setting materials

She is the daughter of Minami Tsubame, a teacher at Keiyo University Fujikawa High School, and a third-year student at the same school. Often relied upon by everyone due to her strong personality, she knows many people in town, and even the local rough characters respect Setsuka.

After a fight with her mother over her post-graduation plans, she ran away from home and sought advice from Inaho Shin, who has been friends with her family since her childhood. Currently living alone in the second-floor room of YuKuRu, which is under repair. Through her interactions with Itsuki, who was asked by Minami Tsubame to find Setsuka, she confronts her mother and thinks about what she wants to do.
translated from digital setting materials
A lively friend of Itsuki. They play retro games together. He often shares his self-styled theories on love, but they are all useless, leading those around him to call him a regrettable handsome man.
Despite being mentally exhausted due to constant family discord and his mother being coerced into a "family", he continues his friendships with Itsuki and Nene without showing it outwardly.
translated from digital setting materials

A father of three daughters and a devoted husband. His own store, YuKuRu, has been closed for an extended period due to an accident involving a car crashing into it. He is currently called back to his former workplace, Ressac, where he is working as a temporary trainer at the Fujikawa store. He is well-known in the local community, with many long-time acquaintances including Minami Tsubame.
translated from digital setting materials

A member of the women's soccer team. She is a classmate of Akira and also her roommate in the dorm. Not only is she enamored with Akira's soccer skills, but she also loves her. It's not just like; it's love. She hopes to go on a date if the chance arises. She shows open hostility towards boys who get close to Akira.
translated from digital setting materials

Her real name is Nakamori Tsubame. Minami is her maiden name. She is a teacher at Keiyo University Affiliated Fujikawa High School, teaching modern literature. She is the homeroom teacher for Itsuki and Nene's class. Her expressions are often abstract and unique, sometimes leaving her students perplexed. While she shows kindness by personally advising her student Sae on career paths, her relationship with her daughter Setsuka is not going very well.
translated from digital setting materials

The head of the occult research department on the verge of closure. She is not good at communicating with people and is usually intimidating, but when it comes to the occult, she becomes aloof and curious, as if she has changed. I am investigating the urban legend "Tanaka Yui Incident" that is said to have occurred at Keiyo University attached Fujikawa High School.

In fact, "Shinonome Rei" is a pseudonym that borrows the name of a friend, and it is also a lie to say that she is the director of the Oka Lab. Her real name is "Tanaka Yui", the same as the schoolgirl who is said to have died in an urban legend.
translated from digital setting materials
